title: Classify exact cube-zero outer-product cost by quadratic relations
body:
This scoped proof answers which cube-zero multiplication maps retain the two-role cost-three outer-product witness. The exact cost is three precisely when the quadratic relation space is zero or an irreducible quadratic line; every other relation space has an explicit cost-two word. It also proves the minimum product-image dimension and gives a five-dimensional attaining algebra when the field has an irreducible quadratic. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged.

[Proof and scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ccd6d17483349ad1995369d4776f96482a40fa60/research/cube-zero-product-map-cost/README.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ccd6d17483349ad1995369d4776f96482a40fa60/research/cube-zero-product-map-cost/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ccd6d17483349ad1995369d4776f96482a40fa60/research/cube-zero-product-map-cost/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ccd6d17483349ad1995369d4776f96482a40fa60/research/cube-zero-product-map-cost/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `ccd6d17483349ad1995369d4776f96482a40fa60`.

The algebra is split commutative local with radical cube zero, and the two chosen elements are independent modulo the radical square. Paid factors are I+u*v^T with base-field right vectors; arbitrary free GL2 maps and singular factors are allowed. The all-field proof includes characteristic two. It classifies this outer-product family, not arbitrary cube-zero targets or every local algebra.

CPython 3.12.14 registered normal and optimized checks pass: all 224 quadratic-relation subspaces over F2,F3,F5,F7, 10320 projective products, 2016 complete basis-input actions and 20 controls. There are 39 exact cost-three contexts and 185 with explicit cost-two constructions. Polynomial-root and product-zero tests agree. Both modes print `PASS_CUBE_ZERO_PRODUCT_MAP_COST`; the launcher prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cube-zero-product-map-cost
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. No extension-field census, predecessor scientific replay, physical coefficient implementation, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run is claimed. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed. Routing, restoration, precision, stock and complete supplier costs remain unpriced. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit Nick Petalas (@petalas) for [PR #4764](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4764), its [pinned witness and product-map question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/cube-zero-three-factor/README.md), and [PR #4276](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4276) with the [exact two-factor criterion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/right-vector-two-factor-criterion/PROOF.md). The alphabet and shared-chart predecessors retain their credit in those sources. Classical binary-quadratic and finite-field facts are not claimed as new. [PR #5320](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5320) treats nonzero first-order pencil lifts, a separate question. The [scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19169243) records the handoff and overlap.

Next: give a physical realization and complete coefficient-operation price for the five-dimensional binary quotient. Fewer algebra dimensions alone do not establish a recursive saving.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
